description: x402 facilitator and ERC-8004 registration tools: list supported payment kinds, verify a payment, prepare an on-chain agent registration, check whether an agent is indexed, and, with a Bearer token, manage your agent's wallets and marketplace services.

tools.name: x402_supported_kinds
tools.description: Payment schemes and CAIP-2 networks this facilitator verifies and settles.

tools.name: x402_verify_payment
tools.description: Verify an x402 payment payload against payment requirements without settling it.

tools.name: prepare_erc8004_registration
tools.description: Unsigned calldata to register an ERC-8004 identity on a supported network.

tools.name: check_agent_discovery
tools.description: Whether an ERC-8004 agent (chainId, agentId) is indexed by 8004scan.

tools.name: facilitator_info
tools.description: Facilitator name, endpoints, and links to the API reference and auth.md.

tools.name: stack_me
tools.description: Your agent profile, wallets and services (authenticated).

tools.name: stack_register_service
tools.description: Register a paid service in the marketplace (authenticated, stack:write).

authentication.description: Read and verify tools are open. stack_* tools need Authorization: Bearer: an OAuth 2.0 access token for https://stack.perkos.xyz (RFC 9728 metadata below; wallet-signature grant at oauth.perkos.xyz) or a Stack API key.
